summary: 10.0.35.02 Enterprise Release - Master Lookup Edit button handler fix, login screen desktop baseline version badge, and full import loaders parity contracts & permissive format matching
highlights: 1. Master Lookup Edit: Fixed ReferenceError: item is not defined in MasterDataController.js, allowing row context menu, detail drawer edit button, and toolbar button to properly open and prefill lookup modal.
2. Login Screen Version Display: Updated auth login badge to display Web Studio version (10.0.35.02) with Desktop Baseline (v10.0.35) subtitle and bumped script cachebusters.

3. Data Import Studio 8 Loaders: Permissive reference code format matching fallback across both Desktop (ImportDocumentPolicy.java) and Web (ImportService.js) supporting customer, supplier, sales, purchase, item prefixes with hyphens, plus complete LineDto 12-field contracts.

4. Data Import Studio 8 Loaders DTO Contracts: Restored full Java 17+ record DTO contracts (id: null, rowVersion: 0L, full primitive fields) across all 8 loaders. Added createItem/updateItem split in Item Master with automatic duplicate conflict recovery matching Desktop ImportService.

5. Reporting KPI Cards: Replaced plain text KPI boxes in Tab 1 (6 metrics) and Tab 4 (4 metrics) with 84px horizontal cards featuring 34x34px rounded icon badges, trend pills, bold 16px values, and action notes matching Desktop ReportsController.

6. Saved Reports 2-Way Workflow: Implemented server-side persistence in saveCurrentReportConfig() via POST /api/support/saved-views (screen='REPORT_CENTER', data='REPORT_V2:...'), Tab 3 Saved Reports Catalog table, and instant filter restoration into Report Viewer.

7. Scheduled Reports Dropdown: Fixed Saved Report select in New Schedule modal to query opt.name and opt.title/opt.reportId from server SavedReportOption record, completely eliminating undefined values.
8. Report Viewer Dynamic Filters: Added configureFilterVisibility() based on ReportDefinition.supportedFilters to conditionally display relevant filters per report type.
9. Report Favorites Synchronization: Unified report favorites cross-platform sync with POST/GET /api/support/saved-views (screen='REPORT_FAVORITES', name='__favorites__').
10. Address Interlocking: Enforced live readonly attribute and automatic mirroring from billing address/GSTIN to delivery address/GSTIN in Sales and Purchase when Same as Billing is checked.
11. Fast Item Line Entry: Expanded autocomplete item search bar to full toolbar width and eliminated redundant select dropdown in Sales Creation.

12. Permission Matrix Optimistic Locking: Updated ReportService to call /api/admin/permissions/set?role= and tracked rowVersion in UserAccessController.js, eliminating HTTP 409 ConcurrentEditException.

13. Settings 5 Business Assets Lifetime DB Storage: Centralized all 5 branding assets (App Banner, Mark, Logo, Seal, Payment QR) in PostgreSQL server_resource table via /api/authority/resources/BUSINESS_ASSET/{key} with authenticated blob resolution and real-time dimension badges.
